```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)

weather <- read.csv("parramatta_weather.csv")

weather$date   <- as.Date(weather$time)
weather$doy    <- as.numeric(format(weather$date, "%j"))
weather$month  <- as.numeric(format(weather$date, "%m"))
weather$season <- factor(
  ifelse(weather$month %in% c(12, 1, 2), "Summer",
  ifelse(weather$month %in% 3:5,         "Autumn",
  ifelse(weather$month %in% 6:8,         "Winter", "Spring"))),
  levels = c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter", "Spring"))
weather$sunshine_hours <- weather$sunshine_duration / 3600

num_vars <- weather[, c("temperature_2m_max", "temperature_2m_min",
                        "precipitation_sum", "wind_speed_10m_max",
                        "shortwave_radiation_sum", "sunshine_hours")]
names(num_vars) <- c("TempMax", "TempMin", "Precip", "WindMax", "Radiation", "SunHours")

skew <- function(x) mean((x - mean(x))^3) / sd(x)^3
r <- cor(num_vars)
n_hot   <- sum(weather$temperature_2m_max >= 35)
pct_dry <- 100 * mean(weather$precipitation_sum == 0)
```
